routes.title: Chat & inline execution cards
routes.before: Replaces the earlier conversation specimen; #conversations remains an alias.
routes.layout: Conversation rail, compact welcome heading, retained Swap/Supply prompts, allocation comparison form, restrained transcript, persistent composer, application action card and separate shared review.
behavior: Prompt suggestions fill the composer; sending an action creates a typed local specimen.
Missing amount/asset and ambiguous Sentora products request clarification. Unsupported venue actions never silently change venue.
Only validated application events may create native action cards in production. Model prose stays escaped/inert.
Preparation, review, blocked, expired, wallet mismatch, signature, submission, reconciliation, partial completion and confirmed states remain distinct.
Stop response does not cancel a prepared plan. Dismiss plan is a separate control.
No automatic spending threshold, delegated signer or mandatory extra caps.
Deposit cards and the shared review keep venue-specific withdrawal conditions visible.

allocation_prompt.placement: Chat welcome state, replacing Compare lending venues and Understand withdrawal timing
allocation_prompt.removed_from: Research / DeFi capital, asset and horizon strip

fields.capital: Positive decimal string; commas accepted and normalized without floating-point conversion

behavior: Compare with Nest submits a read-only comparison prompt using the exact selected amount, asset and horizon.
Invalid or zero amounts stay in the form with an associated error and focus.
The comparison creates no financial action card and cannot sign or submit a transaction.
Selections persist during this page session and return when starting a new conversation.
Private amounts remain out of URLs. Production binds the comparison context to canonical network/asset identity and current source observations.
allocation_prompt.production: Keep comparison intent separate from financial preparation; connect Chat to validated application comparison results.

routes.title: MCP Contents
routes.layout: Venue coverage map with source inspector, then source-family filters, searchable disclosure list and shared numbered pagination.
behavior: MCP Contents starts with the map; source-family filters and a compact disclosure list follow it.
Include 26 unique projects from the captured Scout records, group protocol versions by exact project identity, and distinguish eight integration targets from research coverage.
Share numbered pagination with range, total and current page, 10/25/50 page sizes, disabled boundary actions, filter reset to page one, accessible status and list-context restoration.

sources.observed: Two tools, four source families, structured success/error envelopes, source/as-of caveats. Authenticated runtime access not invoked.

authority: Published research context is not an executable quote. Preserve Pi runtime and Nest application-owned preparation, policy, approval, signature, submission and confirmation.
responsive: Chat transcript scrolls in its own row; composer remains visible without overlaying the transcript.
No redundant assistant launcher on full Chat; contextual drawer remains on other routes.
Map groups use compact project cards; inspector stacks below on small workspaces.
MCP catalog disclosures and numbered pagination fit a 375px viewport.
integration_fields: read groups and typed operation IDs
acceptance: The catalog exposes 60 operations, 20 skills and all 202 section identifiers without implying runtime verification.
Chat exact amounts reach the shared review and remain strings at the boundary.
Preparation and stale/mismatch/blocked cards cannot sign or submit.
Manual forms remain available if AI fails.
No secrets, signed payloads, private context or wallet amounts are placed in URLs.
Exactly three Research tabs: DeFi, RWAs and MCP Contents.
Every map node opens the corresponding DeFi protocol research; legacy links migrate to canonical routes.
Applicable market capabilities and exit conditions appear in protocol detail.
Pagination exposes row range and page position and preserves filters on return.
